interpretation: Task/source indicators are the most consistently useful single feature family, but the effect is controller-dependent. Removing task indicators lowers dense avoidance in five of six controllers; 13B FastV is the exception. Keyword removal has smaller but nonzero effects and lowers coverage in five of six controllers. Question structure alone is useful for some FastV/Random cells but insufficient for 7B SCOPE. No universal single feature family drives every controller.
scope_note: These are development-set, group-aware interpretability results. Each ablation was recalibrated to the same 5% Wilson-risk rule; they are not new prospective controllers.
